input.rationale: Article III (p0048) vests all right, title and interest in the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein in Licensor, and "DERIVATIVE WORK" (p0005) sweeps in any additions, modifications, improvements or enhancements. The customization work we commission and pay for under Article VII(b) (p0087) — a unique client front end and other enhancements to the Platform Software — therefore vests entirely in Licensor, while our only right is the non-exclusive Field-of-Use licence that may not be modified or sublicensed (p0042, p0044, p0047, p0085) and that terminates automatically under Article XXI(a) with a five-day ship-back and officer certification under Article XXI(b) (p0138). That fails the IP fallback: we receive no perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense what we paid for. Licensor's retained ownership of its platform, tools and know-how is acceptable and is left untouched; no Customer IP or data is assigned to Licensor and there is no standing Licensor licence in our data, so we simply confine any such licence to processing to provide the services. The override now reaches both Article XXI(a) and the Article XXI(b) return-and-certify obligation, so the perpetual licence is not hollowed out by a duty to surrender every copy, and the grant is keyed to any statement of work or order as well as Article VII(b). We drafted to the fallback rather than reversing ownership, to avoid collateral rewrites of Articles II, III, VI and XXI.

proposal.summary: Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense customization work we pay for (surviving Article XXI return and certification), and limit any Licensor licence in our data to processing to provide the services.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We pay for the unique client front end and other customization work under Article VII(b), but Article III leaves all of it (and any Derivative Work) with Licensor with no licence back. We have added our fallback position: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense that work for our business, carved out of the Article XXI(a) licence termination and the Article XXI(b) return-and-certify obligation so the licence is genuinely perpetual, plus a limit confining any Licensor licence in our data to processing it to provide the services.

ops.text: CUSTOMIZATION DELIVERABLES. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the restrictions in Articles II and VI and Article XXI(a) and (b), Licensor grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense, for Licensee's business, all development and customization work performed for Licensee under Article VII(b) or under any statement of work or order (the "Customization Deliverables"), and Licensee may retain and continue to use, modify and sublicense the Customization Deliverables and copies thereof after termination. The return and certification obligations in Article XXI(b) do not apply to the Customization Deliverables or to data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Licensee. Any license granted to Licensor in data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Licensee is limited to processing that data solely to provide the services under this Agreement.
